authorityDefinition: A canonical token authority module must be explicitly aggregated by tdm-tokens.sass and expose @mixin tokens. Raw literals are legitimate only as token definitions inside that mixin; directory location alone grants no exemption.
consumerRule: Raw values outside canonical @mixin tokens blocks remain consumer/style evidence and cannot be globally waived by a hardcode gate.
legacyCompatibility: src/shared/styles/tokens.sass remains governed by the Wave 02 compatibility boundary and is not canonical authority.
decision: Classification only. No raw value, token value, component style, or visual output changes are authorized by Wave 04.
